scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Hey, I know you.
You took this test
before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
嘿，我认识你。
你以前参加过这个测试，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Ah, you must have been
to Valhalla and been reborn.
Wow, that's so impressive!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
啊，看来你去过瓦尔哈拉并转生了。
哇，真厉害！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Err...
You'd better learn all the Basic Skills first before you can become an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
那个...
在成为弓箭手之前，你最好先学会所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Alright, see you later.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
好的，回头见。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well then. I don't
need to say anything else.
I know you'll make a great Archer...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
那我就不多说了。
我相信你会成为一名出色的弓箭手...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Although there's no special
reward for you this time, I hope you understand. Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
不过，这次没有特别的奖励，希望你能理解。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Oh...?
Hey, what are
you doing here...?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
哦...？
嘿，你在这里做什么...？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I can tell that you're not cut out to be an Archer. It sort of feels like you're meant to do
something else...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
看得出来，你并不适合当弓箭手。
总觉得你应该走另一条路...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Good day. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你好。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I want to be an Archer.
scripts.translation: 我想成为弓箭手

scripts.text: I need the requirements, please.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我转职条件

scripts.text: Nothing, thanks.
scripts.translation: 没事，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You've already become an Archer...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你已经成为弓箭手了...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Hmm...
You don't look much like a Novice at all...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
嗯...
你看起来完全不像个初心者...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Anyway, whatever you are, you can't choose a job as an Archer because you have a job already.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
总之，不管你是什么职业，既然已经转职了，就不能再成为弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Do you want to be an Archer?
If so, you need to fill out this application form.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你想成为弓箭手吗？
如果是的话，你需要填写这份申请表。

scripts.text: Apply.
scripts.translation: 申请

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Okay, sign here. Alright, um, I'll promote you once you meet the requirements.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
好，在这里签名。
嗯，满足条件后，我就为你办理转职。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
If you think you've met them already, we can check that now.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
如果你觉得已经满足了要求，我们现在就可以检查。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 准备好了

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 还没准备好

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Alright, let me check.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
好的，让我检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I understand. Be my guest if you want to look at the requirements.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
明白了。
想了解转职条件的话，尽管问。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well, alright.
See you next time.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
好吧。
下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Are you...{0}?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你是...{0}吗？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well, you're not at the right job level. Please check the requirements again.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你的职业等级还没达到要求。
请再确认一下转职条件。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Your job level must be at least 10, and don't forget you should learn all of the Basic Skills. Once you've done that, come back.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你的职业等级必须达到10级以上，还要学会所有基本技能，别忘了。
完成后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Excellent!
Now then,
let's see...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
很好！
接下来，让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I will appraise the value of the various types of Trunks, needed to produce a Bow, that you've brought.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
接下来，我会评估你带来的各种制弓木材的价值。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Um...
Unfortunately you didn't bring any of the required items. There's nothing for me to appraise.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
嗯...
可惜，你没带来任何所需的材料，我没法评估。

[Archer Guildsman]
Less than 25!? You have to get a grade of at least 25! Come on, try harder!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
不到25分？！
至少要拿到25分才行！
加油，再努力一点！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Wow! More than 40!
Excellent! Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
哇！超过40分了！
太棒了！恭喜你！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
More than 30! Nice job!
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
超过30分了！
干得不错！
恭喜你！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
*Sigh* Well, you just barely passed... Anyway, well done.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
*叹气*嗯，你只是勉强通过...
不过，还是做得不错。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I'll transfer these Trunks to our Bow Production Department. Now that you've met the requirements, let me promote you right away!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
我会把这些木材转交给制弓部门。
既然你已经满足条件，现在就为你办理转职吧！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Congratulations!
You are now an Archer!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
恭喜你！
你现在是一名弓箭手了！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Of course, we expect that you will help contribute towards the future of the Archer Guild with your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
当然，我们也期待你能通过自己的努力，为弓箭手公会的未来做出贡献。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Ah, your bow has arrived from the Bow Production Department. Here, take it! It's yours~
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
啊，制弓部门把你的弓送来了。
拿着吧，这是你的了~

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Now, off you go. Hunt with pride, knowing you were trained by one of the best!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
好了，出发吧，骄傲地去狩猎！
别忘了，教你的人可是最优秀的导师之一！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I will explain the requirements for being an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
我来说明一下成为弓箭手的条件。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
But...
You're already an Archer. You should know these already...
So...Yeah...no real reason to tell you the requirements...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
不过...
你已经是弓箭手了，应该早就知道这些了吧...
所以...嗯...也没必要再跟你解释转职条件了...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Wait a second. You've chosen a different job already. You don't need to know this~
So...Yeah...no real reason to tell you the requirements...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
等一下，你已经选了其他职业，不需要了解这些啦~
所以...嗯...也没必要跟你解释转职条件了...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
First of all, you have to the Job Level 9 as a Novice, and know all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
首先，你的初心者职业等级必须达到9级，并学会所有基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
An Archer needs extremely high concentration and reflexes, so we do not accept those who have little patience.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
弓箭手需要极高的专注力和反应速度，所以我们不接受缺乏耐心的人。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You also have to gather ^FF0000Trunks^000000. There are 4 different types of Trunks, each of differing quality. You'll be given different grades for your Trunks, depending on their quality.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
你还需要收集^FF0000木材^000000。
木材共有4种，品质各不相同。
我会根据品质，给你带来的木材评分。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
In order to become an Archer, you must receive a grade of at least ^0000FF25^000000 points out of 40. You can get Trunks from 'Willow,' the tree. Be careful, though. They can be tough monsters.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公会成员]
想成为弓箭手，必须在40分中至少拿到^0000FF25^000000分。
木材可以从树精身上获得。
不过要小心，它们可不是好对付的魔物。
